description: This file defines the frontend route/component for user signup in a Remix-based web application. It manages user session checks, handles signup form submission, and renders the signup form UI.

methods.name: meta
methods.description: Sets the page metadata, including title and description.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Redirects to home page if user is already signed in; otherwise, allows access to signup form.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles the signup form submission, creates a user session, and redirects to the main page.
